# The release number and its commit reach every binary's build info, with no declaration in the program.
env GOSMOPOLITAN_RELEASE=412
env GOSMOPOLITAN_RELEASE_REVISION=660ecca3f00d8e1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7
go build
go version -m m$GOEXE
stdout '^\tbuild\trelease=412$'
stdout '^\tbuild\trelease\.revision=660ecca3f00d8e1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7$'

# A new number relinks: the cached binary must not keep the old one.
env GOSMOPOLITAN_RELEASE=413
go build
go version -m m$GOEXE
stdout '^\tbuild\trelease=413$'

# With neither set, the build info names no release.
env GOSMOPOLITAN_RELEASE=
env GOSMOPOLITAN_RELEASE_REVISION=
go build
go version -m m$GOEXE
! stdout 'release'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}
